entries.en: to stay / remain in a place
entries.notes: H「對」tui 非習見之「蹛 tòa」，用字可疑，義依西語詞頭「quedarse en alguna parte」定。

entries.en: to stay; to remain waiting (in a place)
entries.notes: R 欄「chiu toa」與 M 欄重出並附西語「aguardo」，可證「守候」義；本條為圈選重寫。

entries.en: to keep / appropriate what belongs to another
entries.notes: H 欄字形難辨（疑「蜀/溺」），義依 L「quedarse con lo ajeno」定，用字存疑。

entries.zh: 刻虧：使人吃虧、虧待、佔人便宜
entries.en: to wrong (someone); to take unfair advantage of

entries.zh: 克虧：使人吃虧、虧待（上條之重寫）
entries.en: to wrong; to cheat (variant of the preceding entry)
entries.notes: M 欄「car cuy」拼寫異常（克作 car），係上條圈選重寫，義從上條。

entries.zh: 押冬：客居異鄉，留居外地過冬
entries.en: to sojourn abroad over the season; to stay in a foreign land (through the winter)

entries.zh: 守帶（守蹛）：留守、守候原地
entries.en: to stay behind on guard; to remain waiting

entries.zh: 面冷：碰了釘子、被冷落而愣住（期望落空）
entries.en: to be left cold / stunned (one's hopes dashed)
stay here; remain here
entries.notes: 首字疑為「徛/晉」，M 三音與 H 三字對應不齊，義依 L「quedate aqui」。

entries.zh: 做謎：出謎、猜謎（「這是什麼東西」的謎語遊戲）
entries.en: to pose / guess a riddle ('what is it, what is it?')
entries.notes: H「味」為「謎 bī」之借字，L 之「cosa y cosa」即猜謎套語。

entries.en: to play the riddle game; to guess (a riddle)
entries.notes: H「創辨」費解，M 欄附「adiuinar」（猜）明其義，義依 L。

entries.en: to complain; to lodge a complaint
to appeal / complain to the king; to seek redress
entries.notes: H 僅一字「伸」，須與下條「伸告」連讀方足其義。

entries.en: to lodge a complaint / appeal to the king
〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 作 quejarse con el enfermo（向病人訴苦），H 殘、M 僅單音 chan，無法比定。

entries.en: to complain; to bring a complaint

entries.zh: 亂亂孱（讒）：頻頻抱怨、亂訴苦
entries.en: to complain a great deal; to grumble / rail
entries.notes: 中一字殘，末字「孱」疑為「讒」之借，僅「亂亂」與 L「mucho」可對。

entries.en: to plead / complain sorrowfully

entries.zh: 吐氣：嘆氣、唉聲嘆氣地訴苦
entries.en: to sigh; to lament with sighs

entries.zh: 叫苦：訴苦，抱怨命苦或病痛
entries.en: to cry out at hardship; to complain of one's lot or illness
entries.notes: 首字疑「叫/咎」；「叫苦」與 M「quio cou」及 L 義相合，故取叫苦。
